long_biography.plain_text:
Before entering business, Finker was an educator and trained violinist in Kazan. He helped establish a community college there, then moved to Jacksonville as a visiting professor in 1991. He soon applied his Russian commercial contacts to a new commodities venture, which became Itera's U.S. foundation.

The company grew from trade into an international natural-gas group, transforming Finker from academic into entrepreneur and shareholder. After his Itera years, he redirected his attention toward domestic capital and operating businesses. That later phase broadened his interests beyond energy, while family giving created a second, civic strand to his career. The progression was unusual: an education specialist became a cross-border trader, company builder and long-term steward of both commercial and charitable institutions.
long_biography.html:
Before entering business, Finker was an educator and trained violinist in Kazan. He helped establish a community college there, then moved to Jacksonville as a visiting professor in 1991. He soon applied his Russian commercial contacts to a new commodities venture, which became Itera's U.S. foundation.

The company grew from trade into an international natural-gas group, transforming Finker from academic into entrepreneur and shareholder. After his Itera years, he redirected his attention toward domestic capital and operating businesses. That later phase broadened his interests beyond energy, while family giving created a second, civic strand to his career. The progression was unusual: an education specialist became a cross-border trader, company builder and long-term steward of both commercial and charitable institutions.
